sentences.en: Okay, here's the headlines.
sentences.zh: 好的，这是头条新闻。

sentences.en: The prosecutors have been arguing that American democracy was really on the line here and that the judge needed to send a message.
sentences.zh: 检察官一直辩称，美国民主确实处于危急关头，法官需要发出一个明确的信号。

sentences.en: The Navy has released a scathing report that detailed problems within training for the elite
sentences.zh: 海军发布了一份措辞严厉的报告，详细说明了精英部队训练中存在的问题，

sentences.en: Navy SEALs.
sentences.zh: 即海军海豹突击队。

sentences.en: Nearly every major airline and even the air traffic control system has had some kind of severe meltdown.
sentences.zh: 几乎每一家大型航空公司，甚至空中交通管制系统，都经历过某种严重的崩溃。

sentences.en: And now we're headed into a really busy summer.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们正进入一个非常繁忙的夏天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, it's the headlines.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这是头条新闻。

sentences.en: I'm Annie Correale.
sentences.zh: 我是安妮·科雷亚莱。

sentences.en: Today's Friday, May 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月26日，星期五。

sentences.en: Here's what we're covering.
sentences.zh: 以下是我们报道的内容。

sentences.en: I'm Alan Foyer.
sentences.zh: 我是艾伦·福耶尔。

sentences.en: And for the last two plus years, I have been covering all of the criminal cases stemming from the January 6th attack at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 在过去两年多的时间里，我一直在报道所有源于1月6日国会大厦袭击事件的刑事案件。

sentences.en: And I just stepped out of the courtroom in Washington, where we saw the longest sentence issued so far in any of the more than 1,000 cases connected to January 6th.
sentences.zh: 我刚从华盛顿的法庭出来，在那里我们看到了在与1月6日有关的1000多起案件中，迄今为止判决时间最长的一次。

sentences.en: On Thursday, Stuart Rhodes, the leader of the right-wing militia The Oath Keepers, was sentenced to 18 years in federal prison for his role in the attack on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四，右翼民兵组织“誓言守护者”（The Oath Keepers）的领导人斯图尔特·罗兹因其在袭击美国国会大厦事件中的角色，

sentences.en: Capitol.
sentences.zh: 被判处18年联邦监禁。

sentences.en: He was found guilty of organizing The Oath Keepers to use physical force that day to try to stop the transfer of power.
sentences.zh: 他被判组织“誓言守护者”在那天使用武力，试图阻止权力移交的罪名成立。

sentences.en: So over the course of almost three and a half hours, there was quite a bit of drama at the hearing.
sentences.zh: 在近三个半小时的时间里，听证会上发生了不少戏剧性的场面。

sentences.en: Rhodes, wearing his orange prison smock and his trademark black eye patch, got up to the podium
sentences.zh: 罗兹穿着橙色的囚服，戴着他标志性的黑色眼罩，走到法庭的讲台上，

sentences.en: in the courtroom and addressed the court and essentially tried to present himself as the victim here.
sentences.zh: 向法庭陈述，本质上试图将自己塑造成受害者。

sentences.en: He compared himself to Alexander Solzhenitsyn, the Soviet-era dissident, and said that he was like the main character of Kafka's novel, The Trial.
sentences.zh: 他将自己比作苏联时代的异见人士亚历山大·索尔仁尼琴，并说自己就像卡夫卡小说《审判》中的主角。

sentences.en: At one point, he said, I am a political prisoner.
sentences.zh: 在某一时刻，他说：“我是一名政治犯。”

sentences.en: Now, the judge in this case, Amit Mehta, did not take kindly to that description.
sentences.zh: 现在，本案法官阿米特·梅塔并不认同这种说法。

sentences.en: And at one point, he looked down from the bench at Rhodes saying, you, sir, present an ongoing threat and a peril to this country, to the republic, and the very fabric of our
sentences.zh: 在某一时刻，他从法官席上俯视罗兹说：“先生，你对这个国家、对共和国以及我们民主的根基，

sentences.en: democracy.
sentences.zh: 构成了持续的威胁和危险。”

sentences.en: So look, the prosecutors went into this hearing asking for an even higher sentence.
sentences.zh: 所以，你看，检察官在这次听证会上要求判处更重的刑罚。

sentences.en: They wanted Rhodes to serve 25 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 他们希望罗兹入狱25年。

sentences.en: And their arguments were simply that there needed to be accountability for the violence at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 他们的论点很简单，即必须为国会大厦的暴力事件负责。

sentences.en: And that really, American democracy itself was on the line in terms of how Rhodes was sentenced.
sentences.zh: 而且就罗兹的判决而言，美国民主本身确实处于危急关头。

sentences.en: Now, they did not get the full 25 years they requested, but 18 years is still an incredibly significant penalty.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们没有得到所要求的全部25年刑期，但18年仍然是一个极其沉重的惩罚。

sentences.en: Rhodes is one of several Oath Keepers to be sentenced this week.
sentences.zh: 罗兹是本周被判刑的几名“誓言守护者”成员之一。

sentences.en: One of his deputies, Kelly Meggs, was also sentenced Thursday to 12 years.
sentences.zh: 他的副手之一凯利·梅格斯也在周四被判处12年监禁。

sentences.en: And hearings will continue today.
sentences.zh: 听证会将于今天继续进行。

sentences.en: Here's what else we're covering.
sentences.zh: 以下是我们报道的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Navy released a report that detailed in pretty scathing language problems at the Navy
sentences.zh: 周四，海军发布了一份报告，用相当严厉的措辞详细说明了海军海豹突击队

sentences.en: SEALs Elite Selection Course.
sentences.zh: 精英选拔课程中存在的问题。

sentences.en: My colleague Dave Phillips covers the military.
sentences.zh: 我的同事戴夫·菲利普斯负责报道军事新闻。

sentences.en: Last year, his reporting revealed serious safety concerns at a Navy SEALs training course.
sentences.zh: 去年，他的报道揭露了海军海豹突击队训练课程中存在的严重安全隐患。

sentences.en: Days after his reporting came out, the Navy ordered its own investigation.
sentences.zh: 在他的报道发布几天后，海军下令进行了自己的调查。

sentences.en: What I uncovered and what the Navy's review also found is that over time, this course grew brutally hard and led to the death of a sailor in the course.
sentences.zh: 我所揭露的以及海军审查所发现的，是随着时间的推移，这门课程变得极其残酷，并导致了一名水兵在训练中死亡。

sentences.en: The Navy SEALs selection course is really seen as a gold standard of how to train special forces, not just in the United States, but around the world.
sentences.zh: 海军海豹突击队的选拔课程被视为特种部队训练的黄金标准，不仅在美国，在全世界也是如此。

sentences.en: The training course culminates in something called Hell Week, which is several days of constant, grueling exercise and physical and mental tests
sentences.zh: 训练课程的高潮是所谓的“地狱周”，即连续几天不间断、艰苦卓绝的锻炼以及身体和心理测试，

sentences.en: with almost no sleep, oftentimes with prolonged periods in frigid water in the Pacific, and very few people make it through.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有睡眠，通常还要在太平洋冰冷的海水中长时间浸泡，很少有人能坚持下来。

sentences.en: In recent years, that already hard course became even tougher when a new Navy leadership team came in and decided that they needed to push even further.
sentences.zh: 近年来，当新的海军领导团队上任并决定需要进一步加大强度时，这门本已艰难的课程变得更加严酷。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, classes started getting very little rest, spending more time in the frigid Pacific, and doing multiple reps
sentences.zh: 突然之间，学员们几乎得不到休息，在冰冷的太平洋中待的时间更长，并且要重复进行

sentences.en: of exercises that were already designed to take people to the limit.
sentences.zh: 那些本就旨在挑战人体极限的训练项目。

sentences.en: That creep in intensity in the course reaches breaking point in February of last year when Kyle Mullen, a former football player from Yale
sentences.zh: 这种强度的逐渐增加在去年2月达到了临界点，当时凯尔·穆伦，一名来自耶鲁大学的前橄榄球运动员，

sentences.en: who was in that course, died at the end of Hell Week.
sentences.zh: 在课程中，死于“地狱周”结束时。

sentences.en: He had been suffering for days with obvious breathing problems and other ailments that turned out later to be a very serious case of pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 他已经连续几天出现明显的呼吸困难和其他疾病，后来证实是严重的肺炎。

sentences.en: When other students wanted to call 911 because he was having trouble breathing, the doctor on duty
sentences.zh: 当其他学员因为他呼吸困难想要拨打911时，值班医生

sentences.en: dissuaded them twice from doing so, saying that it would interfere with his training.
sentences.zh: 两次劝阻他们，称这会干扰他的训练。

sentences.en: When Kyle Mullen died, all of the problems that had been brewing in the months before were revealed.
sentences.zh: 当凯尔·穆伦去世时，之前几个月里一直在酝酿的所有问题都暴露了出来。

sentences.en: Now the Navy has laid out all those problems in pretty extensive detail and is now proposing some fixes.
sentences.zh: 现在海军已经相当详尽地列出了所有这些问题，并正在提出一些补救措施。

sentences.en: Eight sailors in charge of training and medical care were transferred out of the program, and a number of them have been referred to Navy legal officials for possible punishment.
sentences.zh: 八名负责训练和医疗护理的水兵被调离了该项目，其中一些人已被移交给海军法律部门，以进行可能的惩处。

sentences.en: The Navy is also talking about doing better training, better communication, better
sentences.zh: 海军也在谈论要进行更好的训练、更好的沟通、更好的

sentences.en: documentation of injuries, better oversight to make sure that this course doesn't drift again into dangerous waters.
sentences.zh: 伤害记录以及更好的监督，以确保这门课程不会再次陷入危险的境地。

sentences.en: But fundamentally, there's still this larger problem that if you have this type of very physically demanding training, there's going to be inherent risk.
sentences.zh: 但从根本上说，更大的问题依然存在：如果你进行这种高强度的体能训练，就必然存在固有的风险。

sentences.en: And it's very difficult to manage a program like that without people getting hurt.
sentences.zh: 而且在不造成人员伤亡的情况下管理这样一个项目是非常困难的。

sentences.en: And finally, today kicks off one of the busiest travel weekends of the year.
sentences.zh: 最后，今天开启了年度最繁忙的旅行周末之一。

sentences.en: The TSA is predicting that as many as 10 million passengers will fly in the next few days, the start of what they expect to be a record-breaking summer.
sentences.zh: 美国运输安全管理局（TSA）预测，未来几天将有多达1000万名乘客乘机出行，这标志着他们预计将迎来一个破纪录的夏天。

sentences.en: The surge is coming in a year when the airline industry has been plagued by massive disruptions and widespread flight cancellations.
sentences.zh: 这一激增发生的一年里，航空业一直饱受大规模中断和广泛航班取消的困扰。

sentences.en: The industry as a whole is really under the microscope.
sentences.zh: 整个行业确实处于显微镜下。

sentences.en: My colleague Neeraj Chakshi covers aviation for The Times.
sentences.zh: 我的同事尼拉杰·查克希为《时报》报道航空业。

sentences.en: The consequences of getting it wrong aren't lost on the airlines or the FAA.
sentences.zh: 航空公司或联邦航空管理局（FAA）都很清楚出错的后果。

sentences.en: They've been doing a lot of work to try to avoid any major problems this summer.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在做大量工作，试图避免今年夏天出现任何重大问题。

sentences.en: The airlines have been staffing up.
sentences.zh: 航空公司一直在增加人手。

sentences.en: They've been trying to pay a little bit better attention to early signs of disruptions.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在努力更加关注中断的早期迹象。

sentences.en: And they've even started flying fewer flights but with bigger planes.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至开始减少航班数量，但改用更大的飞机。

sentences.en: So they can still fly as many passengers as they want but not have as many flights in the air.
sentences.zh: 这样他们仍然可以运送尽可能多的乘客，但空中的航班数量不会那么多。

sentences.en: And that hopefully will provide some relief to the air traffic control centers that are short-staffed as well.
sentences.zh: 希望这能为同样人手不足的空中交通管制中心提供一些缓解。

sentences.en: Another thing that they've done, which I know sounds sort of weird, but the private space industry has really boomed in the last few years.
sentences.zh: 他们做的另一件事，我知道听起来有点奇怪，但私人航天工业在过去几年里确实蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: And as a result, there have been a lot more space launches.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，太空发射次数多了很多。

sentences.en: And those launches have competed with airlines for airspace.
sentences.zh: 而这些发射与航空公司争夺空域。

sentences.en: So the FAA said, look, you know, we're going to take a hard look at this.
sentences.zh: 所以联邦航空管理局说，看，你知道，我们要认真审视一下这个问题。

sentences.en: We're going to make sure that, you know, these space launches interfere as little as possible when we can control that.
sentences.zh: 我们要确保，你知道，在我们可以控制的情况下，这些太空发射尽可能少地造成干扰。

sentences.en: Already, you know, the Transportation Department is looking at strengthening the rules around when airlines are required to compensate passengers for disruptions.
sentences.zh: 交通部已经在考虑加强关于航空公司何时必须赔偿乘客因中断造成损失的规定。

sentences.en: And if the industry doesn't get it right this summer, you could have millions of travelers reaching out to lawmakers
sentences.zh: 如果航空业今年夏天处理不好，可能会有数百万旅客向立法者求助，

sentences.en: like they did over the winter holidays, like they did in early January when the air traffic control system went down.
sentences.zh: 就像他们在冬季度假期间所做的那样，就像1月初空中交通管制系统瘫痪时所做的那样。

sentences.en: And, you know, all of that anger and all of that frustration could end up giving momentum to stronger federal rules against the industry.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，所有这些愤怒和沮丧最终可能会推动针对该行业的更强有力的联邦法规出台。

sentences.en: Those are the headlines.
sentences.zh: 以上就是头条新闻。

sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代于夜店当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去工作，你把DJ台变成了一个

sentences.en: like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 像是一个充满美丽、50年历史文物的活体快闪博物馆。
